recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work on additional EUDAMED safety codes should proceed under FHIR-40909 or a terminology follow-up, not as a correction to FHIR-11111.
issue_request: FHIR-11111 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Device after the DSTU2 ballot. It requested a repeatable CodeableConcept safety-characteristic element so Device could convey additional latex-related safety information, using existing GUDID-style safety concepts and marking the element as summary.
initial_application: Historical commit 6af0b8c30aa11aac02a776420fb44ef2b080e463, tagged "[#11111],[#11110]", added Device.safety as a 0..* summary CodeableConcept and introduced a device-safety code list plus a Device UDI example. Later source refactors converted that spreadsheet source into the current StructureDefinition XML without losing the element.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml is in current build scope. The current Device.safety element remains 0..* CodeableConcept, isSummary=true, and has an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-safety. The current device-safety ValueSet includes natural rubber latex concepts. Later FHIR-32573 explicitly added the Device.safety value-set binding; FHIR-40909 asks for additional EUDAMED examples but is only Resolved - change required and still awaiting terminology input.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the current authoritative source already conveys the requested Device latex safety characteristic support.

This later issue proposes additional EUDAMED examples but is not Applied/Published and remains pending terminology input.
